grok.pulse: NQ futures ripped back from a ~2.4% overnight blue-wave flush to modestly green (~+0.2% to +1%) after Trump accepted the results, with AMD/SMCI/ANET beat-and-raise AI prints leading, offset by Goldman flagging Dem-driven data-center moratorium risk and Brent still ~$103.
grok.bias: mixed — AI earnings (AMD ~+7% pre) and the overnight V-reversal are risk-on, but data-center/AI regulation fears after the Dem sweep, Musk names -4% and elevated oil keep the open two-way.
items: @SaloneStephen (~7:10 AM ET): Nasdaq futures were down as much as 2.4% on the Dem House+Senate sweep, flipped green after Trump said he'd accept results; TSLA/SPCX -4%+ pre — Mixed NQ
@astroman0079 (~6:20 AM ET): AMD ~+7% premarket after Q3 beat (rev $13.38B, DC record $8.55B, Q4 guide ~$17B, 2027 growth >80%); SMCI ~+6% and ANET higher on beat-and-raise — Bullish NQ
@DeItaone (~7:02 AM ET): Goldman warns Democratic state/local wins could trigger data-center construction moratoria hitting ~45% of planned US capacity — Bearish NQ
@LiveSquawk (~7:00 AM ET): UBER Q3 adj EPS 88c vs 87c, rev $14.77B vs $14.65B, bookings in line; Q4 EPS guide 95-99c vs 98c est — Mixed NQ
@claudefinancial (~6:01 AM ET): Brent ~$103/bbl as Iran's speaker hails vote as 'NO TO WAR'; QQQ ~+0.6% pre — Mixed NQ
grok.trump: On Fox after the midterm losses, Trump blamed high gas prices from the Iran conflict (national avg ~$4.15) for the setback, called it a short-term hit for long-term security, accepted the results, and kept military force on the table vs Iran.
grok.watch: ISM Services 10:00 AM ET (fcst 54.8 vs 54.9); QCOM AMC (4:45 PM call), ARM AMC (5 PM call), APP AMC; jobless claims Thu 8:30 AM, IREN Thu AMC; NFP Fri 8:30 AM (fcst 65K); Iran strike/talks and Hormuz headlines; AI/data-center regulation chatter.

reports.pulse: Futures recover from overnight blue-sweep dump on AI regulation fears as Trump accepts midterm results and oil softens on Iran de-escalation hopes, leaving the tape mixed into the cash open.
reports.bias: mixed — Democratic Congress gridlock and cheaper oil support risk-on historical patterns, but residual AI/data-center scrutiny and Iran tension risks keep it balanced.
items: Reuters (~3:35 AM ET): US stock futures rise reversing sharp early losses after Democrats' midterm sweep; Trump accepts results and notes Iran war role
CNBC (~12:16 AM ET): SpaceX and Tesla fall over 4% on Dems' big win; AI stocks mixed with Nasdaq-100 futures up ~1% later, AMD +6% on earnings
L'Orient Today/AFP (~4:07 AM ET): Oil stabilizes choppy as markets await Iran-US talks despite airstrikes; Trump says oil plummeting because no war expected
@TConceptTrading (prior): US strikes Iran Qeshm Island yet peace talks advance; Brent spikes then reverses, Nasdaq +0.83% as chips rebound
X traders (~session): Nasdaq futures bounce +500 pts on threat of major military action to Iran after initial election selloff
reports.trump: Accepted election results and acknowledged the Iran war contributed to Republican midterm losses; previously stated oil prices are plummeting because people feel there will be no war with Iran.
reports.watch: Wednesday cash open follow-through on NQ/ES after futures recovery; oil/Iran de-escalation vs residual Hormuz/strike headlines; AI complex reaction to potential Dem regulation and data-center scrutiny; residual fiscal gridlock risk into next sessions.
